I am renting this small plot and my money is tight, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer or pesticides for it—I need to save any subsidized inputs for my main maize land. I will spread some manure from my livestock to keep the soil fertile, and I will plant with local seed I kept from last year because it is free and I know it grows here. There is no irrigation on this land, so I must wait for the rains, but my family can handle all the planting, weeding, and harvesting since it is only 0.12 hectares.
